author: jannerboy
body:
Hi Guys And Pvp team  I am so happy that you have worked your butt off. Your all my baes and I love you <3 so I gave you a little break if you want or you can keep practicing. Up to you? I would love to buy you all gold ranks for Christmas but my mum wouldn't let me. So im trying to think of a thing for me to give you. That's why im gonna ask my team. So guys what should I do. The person with either the best or funniest one will get promoted to moderator on the pvp team. Draws end on Christmas day At Idk Any Time I will close. If any draws are after it will not be counted. I will read all of them. Thank you pvp team <3 your so nice to me calling me Jannergod I feel so special xD So I love you all <3
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Enjoy !!!
